hypothesis: Persisting the exact public candleSnapshot row consumed by every prospective MU decision will make archive-versus-live OHLC source parity directly testable without changing the frozen signal, pressure, or execution contract.
decision: Accept the report-only evidence-capture repair and continue prospective MU observation. Do not add MU to v51 and do not claim archive/live parity from one row.

problem_restatement.input: The MU shadow fetched public 15-minute candleSnapshot history for each decision but previously persisted only the derived decision and REST pressure evidence.
problem_restatement.output: An append-only exact source-candle ledger with first-observation timing, historical-warmup classification, prospective classification, identity validation, and conflict rejection.
problem_restatement.success_criteria: At the first new completed boundary, one matching prospective candle and decision are persisted within 15 seconds, with no signer, order surface, retroactive decision, or v51 runtime mutation.
problem_restatement.constraint: This repair may collect evidence only; it cannot promote, route, size, enter, close, or alter a live strategy.

validation_completed: TDD red/green for historical warmup capture, one-time prospective append, cumulative status counts, and changed-candle rejection.
Thirty-five shared MU, HIP-3, CL/SILVER/SKHX observer, and BRENTOIL recorder tests passed without network access.
Ruff check and format passed; all changed files and functions satisfy the 500-line and 50-line limits.
A bounded unsigned mainnet probe captured 191 exact MU candles and no decisions or orders.
The durable MU observer restarted on its preserved cursor and produced one source candle plus one decision at the first new 15-minute boundary.
The existing BRENTOIL candle recorder was refactored onto the shared storage implementation and its regression suite remained green.
validation_still_required: Accumulate a predeclared prospective live candle window rather than relying on one row.
Reconstruct matching archive public-trade OHLC for the same exact bars and compare open, high, low, close, volume, timestamp, and gap semantics row for row.
Compare archived websocket L2 pressure with prospective REST pressure at each identical decision boundary.
Require both long and short MU onset/lifecycle evidence with exact mark, fee, funding, fill, and path coverage before any live-route proposal.
uncertainties_and_failure_modes: One prospective row cannot establish stable source parity or strategy edge.
Public candleSnapshot history may revise an already observed bar; the recorder now fails closed on any changed OHLCV identity.
The first 190 rows were retrieved after their close and are labeled historical warmup, not prospective evidence.
The separate mark recorder began after the first nine MU long onsets, so older censored lifecycles remain unresolved.
No MU short onset has yet been observed, leaving directional coverage one-sided.
falsifier: A changed or duplicate candle identity, missing prospective bar, observation delay above 15 seconds on an eligible decision, non-MU source row, cursor regression, signer/order capability, source-hash mismatch, or any mutation of the v51 runtime invalidates this capture acceptance.

recommendation.Recommendation: Continue the repaired MU report-only observer and open no live route from this evidence.
recommendation.Why now: The missing source-candle evidence defect is closed and the next bars can finally test the exact archive/live signal-source assumption.
recommendation.Evidence reviewed: Runner/storage source, focused tests, bounded public-mainnet probe, durable restart, first prospective candle and decision, and unchanged v51 checkpoint identity.
recommendation.Observed problem or opportunity: MU development economics were promising but technically unresolved and its live signal source could not previously be audited row for row.
recommendation.Applicable market regime: All prospective completed 15-minute MU bars; no regime or side is promoted from the first row.
recommendation.Alternatives considered: Leave decisions without source candles, treat retrospective API history as prospective, or persist exact first-observed rows with conflict rejection.
recommendation.Expected upside: Future MU onset and lifecycle evidence becomes source-attributable, reproducible, and capable of falsifying the archive transfer assumption.
recommendation.Main risks and failure modes: Sparse onsets, no short coverage, source revisions, mark-path gaps, REST/websocket mismatch, and selection bias from the development winner.
recommendation.Validation completed: TDD, shared regressions, lint/format/size checks, mainnet probe, durable restart, and first-boundary runtime acceptance.
recommendation.Validation still required: A predeclared row-parity window, exact pressure parity, exact resolved both-side lifecycles, realistic costs, and untouched forward evaluation.
recommendation.Success metrics: No source conflicts or missing prospective rows; row-for-row OHLC parity or an explicitly quantified mismatch; both-side resolved outcomes; positive after-cost performance excluding the largest winner.
recommendation.Failure / rollback triggers: Stop the research observer on source conflict, cursor regression, incorrect symbol/source, missing bar, authority drift, or repeated recorder faults. No live rollback exists because no live change was made.
recommendation.Confidence level: High on capture correctness; low on MU source parity and profitability until prospective evidence matures.

single_highest_value_next_investigation: At the predeclared MU evidence threshold, compare the exact prospective candleSnapshot rows and REST pressure rows with independently reconstructed archive public-trade OHLC and websocket L2 pressure for identical 15-minute decisions; do not rerun strategy selection.
